item.title: Women’s Basketball Sees Most Wins Since 2019-20
item.description: Despite their being eight games left in the regular season, Pepperdine Women's Basketball has already won their most amount of games in a season since the 2019-20 season. Their next game is Jan. 31, against Santa Clara University in Santa Clara. The post Women’s Basketball Sees Most Wins Since 2019-20 appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Law School Hosts Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for Dual Events
item.description: Pepperdine Caruso School of Law hosted Supreme Court Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for the final round of an annual Moot Court competition and a speaker event. item.title: Women’s Basketball Pulls Off 74-72 Upset Win at Santa Clara
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball pulled off a 74-72 upset win at Santa Clara on Saturday Jan. 31 at the Leavey Center in Santa Clara, Calif. Four Waves finished in double figures with Lina Falk and Shorna Preston leading the way for Pepperdine. The post Women’s Basketball Pulls Off 74-72 Upset Win at Santa Clara appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Men’s Basketball Falls 83-81 In Close Battle at Seattle
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball fell 83-81 in a close battle with Seattle University on Wednesday Feb. 4 at the Redhawk Center in Seattle, Wash. Aaron Clark and Styles Phipps finished as the Waves top two scores, putting up 22 and 18 points respectively. item.title: Global Learning Week Shifts Students’ Lens
item.description: Pepperdine’s 12th annual Global Learning Week took place from Jan. 26-30. Hosted by International Programs, Global Learning Week celebrates global citizenship by deepening Pepperdine students' cross-cultural understanding with diverse events and hands-on activities.
